title: SEC3: run_session_post_starttls duplicates run_session_io setup
description: run_session_post_starttls (lifecycle.rs:241-266) and run_session_io (lifecycle.rs:573-622) are parallel TLS session entry points with near-identical setup: SessionContext::new, starttls_available=false, client_cert_fingerprint, client_cert_der, load_known_groups, tokio::io::split, BufReader::new, then run_command_loop. The only semantic difference is that run_session_io sends a greeting; run_session_post_starttls does not (RFC 4642 section 2.2). This duplication is a maintenance hazard: any new context field (e.g. connection metadata, rate limit state) must be set in both functions. A unified helper that accepts an Option<Response> for the greeting would collapse both into one code path. The one-line difference (whether to send greeting) does not justify duplicating 20+ lines of setup.
